caption: The video captures a time-lapse over a flat grassland horizon, where a large convective storm cloud dominates the sky. A bright white vertical tower rises left of center, while a darker, rain-shaded mass stretches to the right beneath a patch of deep blue sky. A faint rainbow arcs from the lower-left horizon up toward the cloud base, and vertical rain shafts hang from the central underside. Throughout the excerpt the white tower churns and thickens, its cauliflower top holding near the upper edge while the deep blue sky at the top broadens. The dark right-hand mass breaks apart into smaller, whiter, rounded lobes that spread toward the right edge. The rain shafts shift in position and intensity relative to the horizon as the cloud reshapes. The rainbow stays anchored at the lower-left horizon, its arc geometry holding roughly steady even as the cloud base above it changes.
